args.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const roots=['packages/core/docs','docs','.','packages/core'];const files=[];function walk(d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(['node_modules','.git','.archify','archive'].includes(e.name))continue;const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.md'))files.push(p);}}for(const r of roots)if(fs.existsSync(r))walk(r);const uniq=[...new Set(files)];const broken=[];for(const f of uniq){const t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');for(const m of t.matchAll(/\]\(([^)\s]+\.md)(?:#[^)]*)?\)/g)){const target=m[1];if(/^https?:/.test(target))continue;const abs=path.resolve(path.dirname(f),target);if(!fs.existsSync(abs)&&!fs.existsSync(abs+'.md'))broken.push(f+' -> '+target);}}console.log('文档数:',uniq.length);console.log('断链数:',broken.length);console.log(broken.slice(0,20).join('\n'));"
